profile_text.body:
UC Berkeley / vLLM Team is classified as a university lab and is not for-profit. Its associated website is github.com. The text collected from that website describes GitHub as an AI-powered developer platform for developers and open source communities, but it does not discuss the vLLM team itself.

The team's tracked product is vLLM, an open-source, self-hosted, high-throughput inference engine with no external data sharing. The project repository is at github.com/vllm-project/vllm. No litigation cases or MCP servers are associated with the entity.
